_doc: v9.0 LAW-INTENT-DEFAULT — curated archetype defaults. When the raw prompt matches an archetype `match` regex (case-insensitive) and intent runs WITHOUT --interactive, declare-intent.sh pre-fills declared.* from `defaults` and records an `agent-default-archetype` history entry that satisfies the feature-surface confirmation guard WITHOUT an interactive round. Defaults are explicit + overridable (user edits declared.*), so this is not a vacuous PASS — it is a known-product spec the user can accept or change. Keep this catalog small + high-confidence; an unmatched prompt falls through to the full probe + interview. The match regex must be specific enough not to false-fire on unrelated prompts.

defaults.primary_user: general consumer maintaining a social graph — posting updates, following friends, messaging
core_flows: create a post with text + media to the feed
comment and react on a post
send a direct message to another user
success_criteria: a new user can register, post, and see the post in their own feed
two users can friend each other and each sees the other's posts in their feed
a direct message sent by user A appears live for user B without a page reload
out_of_scope: third-party app platform / open graph API

feature_surface.name: auth / accounts
feature_surface.rationale: identity is the root of a social graph
